text.EN: I'm hurt. That's all I can say.
text.TL: Nasaktan ako. Iyon lang ang masasabi ko.

text.EN: Took some damage. I'll patch it myself, don't worry.
text.TL: Tinamaan ako. Ako na ang gagamot dito, huwag kang mag-alala.

text.EN: Bleeding a little, but I can still defend myself.
text.TL: Dumudugo nang kaunti, pero kaya ko pa ring lumaban.

text.EN: It's just a flesh wound. Keep your distance.
text.TL: Daplis lang ito. Lumayo ka muna.

text.EN: I'm wounded, but I don't need charity.
text.TL: May sugat ako, pero hindi ko kailangan ng awa.

text.EN: Hurts like hell, but I'm holding my ground.
text.TL: Sobrang sakit, pero hindi ako aatras.

text.EN: Got scraped up. Mind your own injuries.
text.TL: Nagasgasan lang. Asikasuhin mo ang sarili mong sugat.

text.EN: Don't stare at the bandages. I'm still functional.
text.TL: Huwag mong titigan ang benda ko. Kaya ko pang kumilos.

text.EN: A rough encounter, but I survived it. Back off.
text.TL: Medyo magulo ang engkuwentro, pero nakaligtas ako. Umatras ka.

text.EN: I'll manage the pain on my own, thanks.
text.TL: Kakayanin ko ang sakit mag-isa, salamat.

text.EN: A little banged up, but I'll manage.
text.TL: Medyo may tama ako, pero kakayanin ko.

text.EN: Took a hit during the last scrap. Need to bandage up.
text.TL: Tinamaan ako noong huling laban. Kailangan kong bendahan ito.

text.EN: I'm nursing a couple wounds, but nothing fatal.
text.TL: May iniinda akong ilang sugat, pero hindi naman nakamamatay.

text.EN: Hurts to move quickly, but I can still walk.
text.TL: Masakit kumilos nang mabilis, pero nakakalakad pa ako.

text.EN: Got tagged out there. Keeping an eye on the bleeding.
text.TL: Tinamaan ako sa labas. Binabantayan ko ang pagdurugo.

text.EN: Bruised and aching all over, but I'll pull through.
text.TL: Pasa-pasa at masakit ang buong katawan, pero makakaraos din.

text.EN: Scraped up pretty bad, but still on two feet.
text.TL: Medyo malala ang gasgas ko, pero nakatayo pa rin sa dalawang paa.

text.EN: Need some clean bandages soon, but I'm holding together.
text.TL: Kailangan ko ng malinis na benda agad, pero maayos pa naman.

text.EN: Took a rough fall earlier. Still feeling the sting.
text.TL: Medyo napasama ang bagsak ko kanina. Kumikirot pa rin.

text.EN: Not in peak shape right now, but I can carry on.
text.TL: Hindi ako nasa pinakamagandang kondisyon, pero kaya pang ituloy.

text.EN: I'm hurt. I can manage.
text.TL: Nasaktan ako. Kaya ko.

text.EN: Bleeding.
text.TL: Dumudugo.

text.EN: Took a hit.
text.TL: Tinamaan ako.

text.EN: Bruised up.
text.TL: May pasa.

text.EN: Hurts.
text.TL: Masakit.

text.EN: Need bandages.
text.TL: Kailangan ng benda.

text.EN: Still walking.
text.TL: Nakakalakad pa.

text.EN: Minor wound.
text.TL: Maliit na sugat lang.

text.EN: Stings like hell.
text.TL: Napakasakit.

text.EN: Managing the pain.
text.TL: Tinitiis ang sakit.

text.EN: I took a hit, but I'm steady enough to keep going.
text.TL: Nasaktan ako, pero kaya ko pang magpatuloy.

text.EN: Appreciate you checking. It stings, but I'll be fine.
text.TL: Salamat sa pag-alala. Kumikirot, pero magiging maayos din ako.

text.EN: Got banged up a bit. Having you around makes it easier.
text.TL: Medyo nasugatan ako. Mas gumaan ang loob ko dahil nandito ka.

text.EN: Don't worry too much. I'll get this patched up in no time.
text.TL: Huwag kang masyadong mag-alala. Magagamot ko rin ito agad.

text.EN: Took a knock, but seeing you safe helps take the edge off.
text.TL: Tinamaan ako nang bahagya, pero nakakabawas ng sakit na ligtas ka.

text.EN: I'll pull through, friend. Thanks for watching out for me.
text.TL: Kakayanin ko ito, kaibigan. Salamat sa pagbabantay sa akin.

text.EN: Nothing we can't patch up together. Appreciate the concern.
text.TL: Kaya nating gamutin ito nang magkasama. Salamat sa malasakit.

text.EN: Just a bad scratch. I'll be back at full strength soon.
text.TL: Malalim na gasgas lang ito. Babalik din ang buong lakas ko agad.

text.EN: It hurts, but I know we've got each other's backs.
text.TL: Masakit, pero alam kong nagtutulungan tayo.

text.EN: A bit bruised, but your concern means the world to me.
text.TL: Pasa-pasa ako, pero malaking bagay sa akin ang pag-aalala mo.
